Deletion is permanent and immediate: there is no bin and no way to recover your history afterwards.
Your account: username, email address and password.
Your profile: weight, height, age, experience level and goal.
Your profile picture, if you uploaded one.
Your whole training history: routines, sessions, exercises performed, sets with their weights and reps, notes and progress.
Your whole nutrition log: meals, foods eaten and any custom foods you created.
Your body measurements, personal goals and achievements.
Your open sessions and your device identifier for notifications.
Crash reports already sent to Firebase Crashlytics, which are anonymous and not linked to your account.
Foods from the general catalogue, which are not yours and hold no personal data.
Server technical logs, which hold no identifiable personal data.
If you only want to stop using the app for a while, you do not need to delete anything: signing out is enough. Your history will be waiting.
If what you want is a copy of your data before deleting it, ask for it at soporte@gymprofit.app and it will be sent to you.

To ring right when your rest is over, even with your phone in your pocket, GymProFit needs the “Alarms & reminders” permission. It only uses it for rests.
To let you know when your rest is over, even with your phone in your pocket, GymProFit needs to be able to send you notifications.
Without it, with the screen off the alert may come late. You can allow it any time in Settings.
